title: dryopteris iranica
intro: Dryopteris iranica, commonly known as the Iranian shield fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is a medicinal plant used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris iranica include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been identified in various studies.
